canonical_data: In-browser conversation and action history kept by the extension; no server-side store
current_repo_note: Last functional commit and release (v0.1.13) landed 2025-11-22; the only later commit (2026-08-18) was a README edit. Several feature/fix PRs opened through September 2026 remain open and unmerged.
strengths: Everything executes client-side in the browser; API keys and credentials never leave the user's machine
Planner/Navigator split lets the Planner self-correct and redirect the Navigator on obstacles
Per-agent model assignment across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, Groq, Cerebras, Llama, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints
weaknesses: No functional commit merged since November 2025 (v0.1.13); only a README update since, despite active incoming PRs
Chrome and Edge only; Firefox, Safari, and other Chromium variants are explicitly unsupported
No documented checkpoint/replay mechanism beyond in-panel conversation history
why_it_matters: A privacy-preserving, bring-your-own-key alternative to hosted browser-operator products, though its maintenance pace has slowed sharply over the past year.
